assertions.assertion: Mentions ISamlSigninStateStore for distributed sign-in state persistence
assertions.rationale: Never mentions ISamlSigninStateStore; only refers generically to 'SAML session/state' storage.

assertions.assertion: Mentions ISamlLogoutSessionStore for distributed SLO session tracking
assertions.rationale: Never mentions ISamlLogoutSessionStore; refers only to generic 'session/logout state' in a shared operational store.

assertions.assertion: Recommends persistent storage (EF Core, Redis) instead of in-memory for multi-node
assertions.rationale: Explicitly recommends replacing in-memory registrations with persistent shared stores using EF Core / Redis.

assertions.assertion: Notes that without distributed stores, SSO/SLO state is lost across nodes
assertions.rationale: Notes in-memory state is per-process so different nodes see different data and node restarts lose it, conveying state loss across nodes.
